name: Elven Crown (Major Artifact)
body:
Aura strong abjuration, conjuration (healing), and divination; CL 20th; Slot head; Price —; Weight 3 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This delicate circlet appears to be made of living blue-green vines with tiny leaves. Clearly of elven manufacture, the interlocking vines occasionally shift and grasp each other in new configurations. In the springtime the crown sprouts crystalline flowers which eventually fall off but retain their beauty (the elven monarch has a tradition of giving these flowers to favored citizens).

At will, the wearer may use detect poison, heal, light, or break enchantment as a standard action. Once per day the wielder may use heroes’ feast and resurrection.

If the wearer is the properly anointed ruler of the elves, the wearer gains a +2 enhancement bonus to Wisdom and Charisma. The wearer may use scrying at will on any of their subjects (any elf who acknowledges the wearer’s authority as the elven monarch). The wearer and any subjects within 60 feet gain the benefits of a good hope spell at all times. Three times per day while within the elven homeland the wearer may create a guards and wards effect.
